The deepseek model successfully reviewed both files and correctly identified the PKGBUILD as a standard, safe Rust build script with pinned dependencies and valid checksums. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model failed to evaluate .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error, resulting in an inconclusive file verdict that cascaded to an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model completed the audit without errors and found the package safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent them from causing inconclusive verdicts.
Differentiate between tool errors and genuine security inconclusiveness; a failure to parse non-executable metadata like .SRCINFO should not override a clean verdict on the executable PKGBUILD.
